title: OSHWC private-beta review decision
authorityBoundary: The deterministic rule executes before retrieval and provider output.
Complete and reported-gap inputs remain specialist-review.

Retrieval and provider output cannot infer customer applicability, establishment classification, worker thresholds, registration/licence liability, substantive safety or working-condition duties, incident findings, penalties or remedies, and cannot alter the deterministic result.
privacyBoundary: No names, contact details, addresses, registration numbers, employee identities, age or sex data, schedules, attendance, payroll, wages, appointment letters, medical or health records, accident or dangerous-occurrence narratives, licences, certificates, notices, orders, penalties, disputes or evidence bodies.

Only controlled Central/Maharashtra source-route, source-status, draft-final reconciliation, generic establishment-control, deferred-special-category, specialist-escalation statuses and source references may be processed.
sourceBoundary: The OSHWC Code and Central Rules reuse existing source-identity registrations from Wave 5A; exact full controlled files remain a source-file approval dependency.
S.O. 5321(E) and both Maharashtra 2026 rule sets are curated official source identities pending exact controlled full-file mirrors.
The Maharashtra Labour and Factories/Other Ports rule sets are drafts and may never be treated as final or operative without a separately controlled final instrument and qualified approval.
Contract labour, inter-State migrant workers and other Chapter XI or industry-special source packs remain outside Wave 5F.

approval.notes: Software implementation and tests do not constitute legal, privacy, RAG, source-file, security or release approval.
